title: Treasure hunt in the Divine Wood Palace
summary: Wu Yingying accuses Mu Chen of an old wrong from the Spiritual Land while a Greenwood Beast at the Spiritual Energy Disaster guards the Celestial Spirit Tree. Mu Chen fends off the beast and takes the whole tree rather than a share of the fruit, which enrages Wu Yingying. Mu Fengyang throws the real Spiritual Fruit to Xia Hou to shift the chaos onto him, and Xia Hou's Holy team and Tang Mei'er's Phoenix team clash. Xia Hou tries to kill for the treasure with the Divine Art Inscription, then admits he is working with the hidden team. Their leader, from the Wood Spirit Academy, steps out with three lifeless puppets and opens the Realm of Ten Thousand Trees, which starts draining everyone's spiritual power. Xia Hou fights Mu Chen and Luo Li inside the barrier with his Stellar Art, while Luo Li resists the draining vines.
